indicator_definition: Number of invasive alien species of EU concern established in member states under Regulation 1143/2014. Invasive species are a leading cause of biodiversity loss. Data maintained by the European Environment Agency.
rationale: Invasive alien species threaten native biodiversity and ecosystem services. Progress means limiting the spread of invasive alien species.
methodology_characteristics: Data maintained by the EEA based on national monitoring reports under the EU invasive alien species regulation. Published as part of the EU biodiversity monitoring framework.
